language.title: Language
language.subtitle: Choose the language for the Cognos interface. Your choice is saved to your account and applies on all your devices.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Your display name appears on your messages and in shared chats.

data.title: Your data
data.subtitle: Download all your conversations and messages — decrypted in your browser — as a JSON file.

email.title: Email
email.subtitle: Your email only signs you in and receives account notices — it never unlocks your data. Changing it is safe and never affects your encrypted chats.

password.title: Password
password.subtitle: Your password only signs you in — it does not unlock your data (that's your Account Key). Changing it is safe and never affects your encrypted chats.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.deleteChatsSubtitle: Permanently delete every conversation and its messages. This can’t be undone.
danger.deleteAccountSubtitle: We permanently delete your account and encrypted chat data, keys and personas. Records required for billing, tax, fraud prevention, or legal compliance may be retained. This can’t be undone.

toasts.emailLinkSentMsg: Open the link we emailed to {{ email }} to finish changing your email.
toasts.deleteAccountConflict: Cancel your plan before deleting your account

errors.passwordChange: Could not change your password. Check your current password and try again.
errors.emailChange: Could not start the email change. Check the address and try again.

login.title: Get started with privacy-first AI
login.lead: Chat with the latest models without giving up control of your data. New devices may also ask for your Account Key.
login.error: We couldn't sign you in. Check your email and password and try again.
login.legalPrefix: By signing up you agree to our

register.title: Create your Cognos account
register.lead: Start with your email and password. Right after signup, Cognos will generate an Account Key for encrypted backup unlock on new devices.
register.legalPrefix: By creating an account you agree to our

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.sent: If an account exists for {{ email }}, we've sent a password reset link. Check your inbox and follow the link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentNote: Your password only signs you in — it never unlocks your encrypted chats, so resetting it is safe and leaves your history untouched.
forgot.lead: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password. Your password is only used to sign in, so resetting it never affects your encrypted chats.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.missingToken: This reset link is missing its token. Request a new link and try again.
reset.success: Your password has been reset. Your encrypted chats are untouched — your password only signs you in.
reset.error: That reset link didn't work — it may have expired or already been used.
reset.lead: Pick a new password of at least 12 characters. Your password is only used to sign in, so this won't affect your encrypted chats.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.success: Your email is verified. Thanks for confirming.
verify.error: That verification link didn't work — it may have expired or already been used.
verify.missingToken: This verification link is missing its token. Try clicking the link from your email again.

confirmEmail.title: Confirm your new email
confirmEmail.lead: Enter your password to finish changing your email. Your password only signs you in — this never affects your encrypted chats.
confirmEmail.success: Your email has been changed. Please sign in again with your new email.
confirmEmail.error: That link didn't work — it may have expired or already been used, or the password was incorrect.
confirmEmail.missingToken: This confirmation link is missing its token. Try clicking the link from your email again.
